sloka: द्र्शयामास शृङ्गाणि सागरेण नियोजितः ।शातकुम्भमयैः शृङ्गैः सकिन्नरमहोरगैः ॥५-१-१०४॥
transliteration: drśayāmāsa śṛṅgāṇi sāgareṇa niyojitaḥ ।śātakumbhamayaiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ sakinnaramahoragaiḥ ॥5-1-104॥

translations.english: At the instance of Varuna, (the presiding deity of the ocean) the lofty mountain appeared, projecting its peaks, hitherto submerged in the water. The golden peaks inhabited by nagas and kinnaras resemmbled the rising Sun as though scraping the sky in a moment.
